_comment: S1 / S1' boosted-cb tagger. Inputs = the 30 independent MASS-DECORRELATED ak8_gpt_* scores (Sophon-style: a generic massive resonance X, no parent-flavour assumption, so equally valid for H+->cb). S1' adds tau21, tau32, nConstituents. Binary: signal = the 4 gen-matched W->cb jet topologies W(cb)/t2(b'c)/t2(b'b)/t3(b'bc); background = every AK8 jet from the 16 non-Vcb samples. Inputs are written p(..) in the plots so they are never confused with the truth topologies.
_run_tag_note: output/<run_tag>/ ; dataset_tag selects the input parquet, run_tag names the training run so re-tunes never clobber.
_train_models_note: S1' dropped as the carried default (agreed: substructure adds ~0 AUC, tau21/tau32/nConstituents rank low) -- also halves wall time on this dataset size (S1 alone took 3412s in the last full run) and reduces exposure to this shared node's memory-pressure kills. Override with train.py --only S1,S1p to train both.
_background_keep_prob_note: base build at the top of the 0.2/0.3/0.4/0.5 scan (scan_keep_prob.py); it sub-thins this dataset in-memory so the expensive ROOT read runs once. Final value picked after the scan.
_class_weight_share_note: the CHOSEN quantity -- target fraction of train-split positive-class sumw per topology: multiplier_c = share_c * total_raw_sumw / raw_sumw_c. Class 6 (Z(bb)-adj) added 2026-09-12: t2_bb's previous 20% share was split into two equal 10% twins -- true t2(b'b) and its Z->bb counterpart -- since z_contamination_study.py showed the tagger cannot distinguish them (mean S1 0.797 for Z(bb)-adj vs 0.834 for true t2(b'b)); every other share is unchanged. Change a share here and just retrain (02_train_tagger.py) -- the multiplier is derived automatically, see class_weight_multiplier below.
_class_weight_multiplier_note: 2026-09-13: this key is now a REFERENCE SNAPSHOT only (last values derived by 02_train_tagger.py's run on presel_v3_kp50_zbb), not a pipeline input -- 02_train_tagger.py derives it fresh every run from class_weight_share + the real train-split per-class sumw (see derive_class_weight_multiplier() there) and never reads or writes this key, so it can't go stale for the main pipeline. Kept here only because scan_keep_prob.py's standalone class_weight_lookup() still reads this key directly; update it by hand (or fix that script to self-derive too) if you change class_weight_share and want the scan to match. Historical context: unweighted, the 5 signal sub-classes' train-split sumw was Wcb 0.38% / t2_bc 0.16% / t2_bb 0.21% / t3_bbc 0.09% / t2_bc_proxy 99.16% (proxy pulled unthinned from the whole 16-sample background pool, Cabibbo-favoured W->cs vastly outnumbers the dedicated Vcb sample) -- the BDT loss was ~99% 'find a proxy-like jet' and Wcb was noise in the gradient. Applied at LOAD time to TRAIN and VALID weight only -- TEST is left at raw physics weight so reported AUC/working-points/per-class efficiency stay physically meaningful.
_features_S1_note: 22 nodes (2026-09-13: +ak8_gpt_qcd, was 21) = the 30-node ak8_gpt_* set (all minus the 2 REMAINING parent sums topbw/topw) with the 10 leptonic top/W-decay categories merged into one ak8_gpt_lepq = their sum, PLUS the QCD parent sum ak8_gpt_qcd re-added on top of its own 5 children (qcdb/qcdbb/qcdc/qcdcc/qcdothers), on the hypothesis (user, 2026-09-13) that the parent softmax output is not a pure arithmetic sum of the 5 children (unlike the verified-lossless lepq merge) and may carry its own separation power from the model's learned QCD-flavour-composition weighting. If it turns out to be an exact linear combination of the 5 children already in the list, a tree model gains nothing from it (permutation importance should then read ~0) -- next training's permutation-importance ranking is the direct test. topbw/topw stay excluded (not requested). The 10 leptonic top/W-decay categories are mutually-exclusive sub-classes of one GloParT parent softmax, so THEIR sum (lepq) is a verified lossless union probability, not a dropped feature -- and all 10 individually contributed <0.0012 permutation AUC (9 of 10 below 0.001; physically expected since our AK8 jet is a hadronic W->cb candidate). cc/qcdbb/qcdcc/topbwcs/qq/ss/tauhtauh were also individually <0.001 but are NOT merged: they are physically distinct categories (not mutually-exclusive sub-classes of one summed parent), so low permutation importance there means 'not needed for this S:B split', not 'redundant' -- kept as-is per instruction.
_derived_features_note: computed at LOAD time in train.py/scan_keep_prob.py (df[name] = df[components].sum(axis=1)) -- the raw components stay in the parquet (build_trainset.py always writes them) so this is a train-time-only reduction, reversible with no rebuild. topbwtaumv (auc_drop 0.00113, the highest of the 10) is included for physical consistency of the group; flag if you want it split out separately instead.
_xgboost_note: point D3 of the regularisation scans: depth 2, min_child_weight 300, subsample 0.5. Background training bias 6.1% (from 14.2%), converges at ~620 of 4000 trees so early stopping decides, 45 s/model. reg_alpha HURTS (10.6%) and max_delta_step does not help. Regularisation saturates ~6%: the residual bias is statistics-limited (halving the background doubles it), so <5% needs background_keep_prob 0.15 -> ~0.40 and a dataset rebuild.
_features_S1p_note: S1' = the 30 GloParT nodes + tau21 + tau32 + nConstituents
